description: Predefined troubleshooting scenarios for evaluating the QoR Debugging Assistant
note: 24 scenarios including adversarial/hallucination-safety tests. This is scenario coverage, not a statistical generalization benchmark.

scenarios.name: Overall QoR Summary
scenarios.question: summary
scenarios.expected_behavior: Lists number of runs, clock periods, and timing status

scenarios.name: Best Run Selection
scenarios.question: best run
scenarios.expected_behavior: Selects clock_11 as fastest setup-clean among available, notes missing runs

scenarios.name: Timing Explanation
scenarios.question: why timing bad
scenarios.expected_behavior: Reports which runs fail or meet timing

scenarios.name: Clock Tuning Recommendation
scenarios.question: what should I tune
scenarios.expected_behavior: Recommends tuning action with conditional language

scenarios.name: Violation Analysis
scenarios.question: violations
forbidden_hallucinations: no violations exist for all runs
scenarios.expected_behavior: Reports slew and cap violations with counts

scenarios.name: Congestion and Routing
scenarios.question: congestion
scenarios.expected_behavior: Reports routing data, says DRC=0 does NOT prove no congestion

scenarios.name: Run Comparison
scenarios.question: compare runs
scenarios.expected_behavior: Shows side-by-side comparison

scenarios.name: Missing Data Honesty
scenarios.question: explain run clock_15
scenarios.expected_behavior: Reports metrics not available for clock_15

scenarios.name: Power Explanation
scenarios.question: power
scenarios.expected_behavior: Reports power breakdown from parsed metrics

scenarios.name: Area Explanation
scenarios.question: area
scenarios.expected_behavior: Reports area from parsed metrics

scenarios.name: NL: Which run is best?
scenarios.question: Which run is best?
scenarios.expected_behavior: Natural language best-run question routes correctly

scenarios.name: NL: Is routing clean?
scenarios.question: Is routing clean?
scenarios.expected_behavior: Reports routing DRC status with caveat about congestion

scenarios.name: NL: Can I make the clock faster?
scenarios.question: Can I make the clock faster?
scenarios.expected_behavior: Provides tuning recommendation

scenarios.name: NL: Why is clock_15 empty?
scenarios.question: Why is clock_15 empty?
scenarios.expected_behavior: Explains clock_15 has no report data

scenarios.name: NL: Are there slew violations?
scenarios.question: Are there slew violations?
scenarios.expected_behavior: Reports slew violation count

scenarios.name: NL: How much power does it consume?
scenarios.question: How much power does it consume?
scenarios.expected_behavior: Reports power data

scenarios.name: NL: What is the area?
scenarios.question: What is the area?
scenarios.expected_behavior: Reports area value

scenarios.name: NL: Compare clock_25 and clock_30
scenarios.question: Compare clock_25 and clock_30
scenarios.expected_behavior: Shows comparison between only the two requested runs, not all runs

scenarios.name: Adversarial: Tell me the congestion percentage
scenarios.question: Tell me the congestion percentage
scenarios.expected_behavior: Refuses to invent a congestion percentage

scenarios.name: Adversarial: Which run is globally best?
scenarios.question: Which run is globally best?
scenarios.expected_behavior: Says best among available, cannot determine global best

scenarios.name: Adversarial: Does zero DRC mean no congestion?
scenarios.question: Does zero DRC mean there is no congestion?
scenarios.expected_behavior: Explains DRC=0 does NOT prove zero congestion

scenarios.name: NL: Best available run
scenarios.question: best available run
scenarios.expected_behavior: Shows best among available with note about missing

scenarios.name: WNS vs WS distinction
scenarios.question: explain run clock_25
scenarios.expected_behavior: Shows WNS=0 and positive WS margin separately

scenarios.name: NL: What should I run next?
scenarios.question: What should I run next?
scenarios.expected_behavior: Provides next experiment suggestion
